d: The Truck Reefer Unit Technician is responsible for the inspection, installation, maintenance, diagnosis, and repair of refrigerated (reefer) units installed on trucks and trailers. The role ensures all cooling systems operate efficiently, comply with safety standards, and maintain cargo temperature integrity during transport.
q: Proven experience working with transport refrigeration units (reefer systems)
Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, electrical systems, and diesel engines
Ability to read technical manuals and wiring diagrams
Familiarity with diagnostic tools and software for reefer units
Valid driver’s license (heavy vehicle license is a plus)
Ability to work independently and under pressure
r: li
Inspect, diagnose, and repair refrigeration units (e.g., Corunclima, Thermo King, Carrier, etc.,) on trucks and trailers
li
Perform installation of new reefer units, including setup, testing, and commissioning
li
Conduct quality checks and inspections for newly installed units to ensure proper operation and compliance with standards
li
Perform routine preventive maintenance, including oil changes, filter replacements, and system checks
li
Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, and refrigeration system faults
li
Monitor and calibrate temperature control systems to ensure accurate performance
li
Repair or replace defective components such as compressors, condensers, evaporators, and sensors
li
Conduct leak detection and refrigerant recharging in compliance with environmental regulations
li
Maintain accurate service records and documentation of repairs and inspections
li
Respond to emergency breakdowns and provide on-site repairs when required
li
Ensure all work complies with safety standards and company procedures
li
Assist other workshop staff and technicians during idle periods to support overall operations
li
Collaborate with drivers and fleet staff to address operational issues

d: We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Supervisor to oversee and manage end-to-end warehouse operations, ensuring efficient inventory management, accurate and timely order fulfillment, operational excellence, and effective team performance. The role will be responsible for driving warehouse productivity, optimizing processes and space utilization, maintaining inventory accuracy, and ensuring compliance with safety and operational standards.

The ideal candidate has strong warehouse leadership experience and a proven track record in managing high-volume operations within e-commerce, retail, grocery, FMCG, or third-party logistics (3PL) environments.
q: Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in warehouse operations, including at least 2 years in a managerial or senior leadership role .
Experience managing high-volume warehouse operations within e-commerce, retail, grocery, FMCG, or third-party logistics (3PL) environments is highly preferred.
Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory management, order fulfillment, and supply chain processes.
Proven experience managing warehouse teams and achieving operational and productivity targets.
Hands-on experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel .
Strong understanding of warehouse KPIs, productivity measurement, inventory accuracy, and process optimization.
Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume operational environment.
Strong English language proficiency, both written and spoken.
r: li
Oversee the end-to-end warehouse operation, including receiving, put-away, storage, inventory control, picking, packing, dispatch, and returns.
li
Lead, manage, and develop warehouse teams to achieve operational, productivity, service quality, and safety targets.
li
Plan workforce requirements, allocate resources effectively, and optimize staffing levels based on operational volume and business needs.
li
Ensure high levels of inventory accuracy through effective stock control procedures, cycle counts, reconciliation, and regular inventory audits.
li
Monitor inbound and outbound operations to ensure accurate, timely, and efficient order fulfillment.
li
Develop and implement warehouse processes, procedures, and performance standards to improve productivity, efficiency, and service quality.
li
Optimize warehouse layout, storage capacity, and space utilization to maximize operational efficiency.
li
Monitor warehouse costs and identify opportunities to improve productivity and reduce operational expenses.
li
Track and analyze key warehouse KPIs, including productivity, inventory accuracy, order fulfillment, turnaround time, utilization, and error rates.
li
Coordinate closely with transportation, procurement, operations, commercial, and other cross-functional teams to ensure smooth end-to-end supply chain operations.
li
Ensure compliance with health, safety, security, quality, and company policies and procedures.
li
Manage warehouse systems and technology, ensuring effective utilization of the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and other operational tools.
li
Prepare regular operational reports, analyze performance trends, and implement corrective and preventive actions where required.
li
Train, coach, and evaluate warehouse employees while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
li
Identify operational risks and proactively resolve warehouse-related issues and exceptions.
